arguments.command:
chmod +x pysemver
python - <<'PY'
import operator
import semver
v = semver.VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 4, 5)
assert tuple(v) == (1, 2, 3, '4', '5')
for name in ('major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build'):
    try:
        setattr(v, name, 9)
    except AttributeError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(name)
release = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
for other in ((1, 2, 3), (1, 2, 3, None), (1, 2, 3, None, 'build')):
    assert release == other and other == release
    assert release <= other and other <= release
    assert release >= other and other >= release
    assert not release < other and not other < release
    assert not release > other and not other > release
    assert not release != other and not other != release
for other in ('1.2.3', 123):
    assert release != other
    for op in (operator.lt, operator.le, operator.gt, operator.ge):
        try:
            op(release, other)
        except TypeError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError((op, other))
for part in ('major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build'):
    original = semver.VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3-rc.9+build.9')
    result = getattr(original, 'bump_' + part)()
    assert isinstance(result, semver.VersionInfo)
    assert str(result) == getattr(semver, 'bump_' + part)(str(original))
    assert str(original) == '1.2.3-rc.9+build.9'
assert semver.replace('1.2.3-rc.9+build.9', major='7', prerelease=None) == '7.2.3+build.9'
assert tuple(v.replace(build=None)) == (1, 2, 3, '4', None)
try:
    v.replace(unknown=1)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('unknown replacement accepted')
assert semver.process(semver.createparser().parse_args(['compare', '1.0.0', '2.0.0'])) == -1
assert semver.main(['check', '1.2.3']) == 0
assert semver.main(['check', 'invalid']) == 2
print('Targeted checks passed')
PY
./pysemver bump major 1.2.3
python -m semver compare 1.0.0 2.0.0
python -m pytest -q
python -m doctest semver.py
git diff --check
